root_cause: The public IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder can be instantiated by the same condition-aware caller whose negative claim it is meant to independently constrain. Its factory seal proves implementation origin and immutability only; it does not prove upstream event-source ownership. The repository admission API therefore had a path where a caller-self-minted structurally complete range with no matching event could receive causal_negative_credit=1.
fix_candidate: Preserve the structural source-range candidate and its sequence/digest/factory validation for conservative cross-checking.
Remove repository-only negative causal promotion from admit_reentry_observation_with_independent_range.

A structurally matching range with no matching reentry now returns NEGATIVE_ABSENCE_UNPROVEN, causal_negative_credit=0, independent_negative_range_authority=false, blocker TARGET_SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE_BINDING_NOT_PROVEN.
A candidate range containing the matching event may still conservatively contradict a caller-negative observation, but it also does not claim independent source authority.
Add an explicit public-self-minted-range regression requiring zero negative causal credit.
next_exact_action: Run exact deterministic release CI on this atomic source/test/pointer subject. If green, reconcile repository fail-closed scope only; target negative causal promotion remains blocked until exact owner-VPS runtime evidence independently binds the range recorder upstream of condition-aware logic.
